# Security and sensitive information

This repository publishes documentation only. It does not include the SCRAPT application runtime, credentials or operational data.

## Reporting a concern

If GitHub private vulnerability reporting is available for this repository, use **Security → Report a vulnerability**. Do not post security-sensitive details in public issues or pull requests.

If that private option is unavailable, ask the maintainers to establish a private reporting channel without disclosing exploit details, credentials or affected account information publicly.

No response-time or remediation SLA is currently published.

## Never submit

- API keys, passwords, access tokens or environment files.
- Account details or personal information.
- Internal application source or proprietary algorithms.
- Databases, runtime snapshots or unredacted logs.
- Executables, model files or build archives.

If a credential is exposed, revoke or rotate it through the relevant service. Removing it from a later commit alone does not make it safe.

Public documentation and examples should contain only material explicitly approved for public distribution.
